name: Chad Hurley
current_role: YouTube co-founder; investor and minority owner of the Golden State Warriors and Los Angeles FC
summary: Chad Hurley, a former PayPal employee, co-founded YouTube in 2005 with Steve Chen and Jawed Karim and was its CEO until 2010, after selling it to Google for $1.65 billion in stock in 2006. He later co-founded AVOS Systems, which bought Delicious, and launched the video app MixBit; he is a minority owner of the Golden State Warriors and Los Angeles FC.
